test_conditional_update: test the nested_updates.conditional_update function to conditionally swap nested JAX tensor structures based on a boolean flag
test_periodic_update: test the nested_updates.periodic_update function to periodically switch nested JAX tensor structures at specified step intervals
test_nested_struct_update: test conditional_update with nested JAX array structures like ((array, array), array) using jax.tree_leaves traversal
test_conditional_update_disabled: test conditional_update returns old_tensors when is_time is False, preserving previous parameter values
test_conditional_update_enabled: test conditional_update returns new_tensors when is_time is True, applying new parameter values
